cohort: 717 mother-infant pairs with singleton pregnancies at 37 to 41 weeks gestation who underwent scheduled cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia
finding: After adjusting for confounders including blood pressure, there was no association between umbilical artery pH and BMI in women undergoing scheduled cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia.
mod_finding: While umbilical artery pH was initially lower in women with BMI ≥40 kg/m(2) undergoing scheduled cesarean delivery, this association disappeared after adjusting for relative hypotension, which is more pronounced with increasing BMI.
